answer: Escrow plus dispute slashing puts a price tag on every fake identity. Entry costs 240 copper locked for 15 epochs, and any challenger has 3 epochs to dispute it before a 9-person jury rules in 2 epochs. A whisper network watches every new entry, and confirmed forgery slashes 80% of the stake, pays 25% to the reporter, and bans re-entry for 12 epochs. Breakeven math: a 1,000-clone batch locks 240,000 units, a 30% catch rate slashes 57,600, and reporters collect 14,400, so each fake identity expects a 57.6-unit loss. Honest identities rest at the oasis; fakes wander.
